description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Dolphins signed LB Shaka Heyward to their 53-man roster.
items.impact: Heyward was signed off the practice squad by Miami.
items.title: Shaka Heyward signs with Dolphins

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Texans signed LB Caleb Johnson to their practice squad.
items.impact: Johnson has 40 career tackles with one forced fumble and one fumble recovery.
items.title: Caleb Johnson signs with Texans

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Browns released OL Kendrick Green from injured reserve.
items.impact: Green will figure to seek another opportunity.
items.title: Kendrick Green released from IR by Browns

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Browns released Messiah Swinson from their practice squad.
items.impact: Swinson will figure to seek another opportunity.
items.title: Messiah Swinson released by Browns

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Browns released D'Angelo Ross from their practice squad.
items.impact: Ross will figure to seek another opportunity.
items.title: D'Angelo Ross released by Browns

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Browns signed John FitzPatrick to their practice squad.
items.impact: FitzPatrick will add depth on the practice squad for Cleveland.
items.title: John FitzPatrick signs with Browns

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Browns signed CB Myles Bryant to their practice squad.
items.impact: Bryant will add depth in the secondary for Cleveland.
items.title: Myles Bryant signs with Browns

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Texans signed WR Treyvhon Saunders to their practice squad.
items.impact: Saunders gets the opportunity after Houston lost Mitchell Tinsley off its practice squad.
items.title: Treyvhon Saunders signs with Texans

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The 49ers hosted WR Brady Boyd for a workout on Tuesday.
items.impact: San Francisco looks to add to its banged up wide receiver room.
items.title: Brady Boyd works out for 49ers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Vikings signed QB Max Brosmer to the 53-man roster.
items.impact: Brosmer will add depth in the quarterback room for Minnesota.
items.title: Max Brosmer signs with Vikings 53-man roster

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Giants released WR Odell Beckham Jr.
items.impact: Beckham had seen just one target through three games to start the season.
items.title: Odell Beckham Jr. released by Giants

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The 49ers hosted CB Sam Webb for a workout on Tuesday.
items.impact: Webb appeared in seven games for the Browns last season.
items.title: Sam Webb works out for 49ers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Ifeatu Melifonwu reached agreement on a one-year deal with the Bucs.
items.impact: Melifonwu earns a spot on the active roster after three elevations from the practice squad.
items.title: Ifeatu Melifonwu signs one-year deal with Bucs

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bengals released WR/KR Ke'Shawn Williams.
items.impact: Cincinnati signed WR Mitchell Tinsley as the corresponding move.
items.title: Ke'Shawn Williams released by Bengals

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bengals are signing WR Mitch Tinsley off the Texans practice.
items.impact: Tinsley will be added to the active roster for Cincinnati. He'll add depth in the Bengals wide receiver room.
items.title: Mitchell Tinsley signs with Bengals

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Browns head coach Todd Monken says Luke Wypler would start at center if Elgton Jenkins doesn't clear concussion protocol.
items.impact: It is a short week for Cleveland against the Steelers on Thursday. The status of Jenkins will need to be monitored in practice on Tuesday and Wednesday.
items.title: Luke Wypler could start at center for Browns Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Rams head coach Sean McVay said CB Jaylen Watson dislocated his shoulder on Sunday.
items.impact: Watson is expected to avoid injured reserve. He is week-to-week as of now.
items.title: Jaylen Watson suffers dislocated shoulder

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said there's no update on RB Zach Charbonnet.
items.impact: They are still deciding on whether Charbonnet will have his practice window opened this week. He can have it opened at any time.
items.title: Zach Charbonnet (knee) uncertain on practicing this week

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald said Julian Love is considered day-to-day.
items.impact: Love did not play in Sunday's loss against the Commanders. "It's a day-to-day thing with Julian [Love]. Things went really well this morning."
items.title: Julian Love (calf) considered day-to-day

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Panthers G Damien Lewis will be out "a few weeks."
items.impact: It is another significant loss for Carolina. The Panthers will be without their starting guard on the offensive line for at least the next few weeks.
items.title: Damien Lewis (elbow) to miss a few weeks

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Ed Oliver (hip) missed Buffalo's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Oliver suffered this hip injury in pregame warmups last week. He was still sidelined at practice on Wednesday, and it looks like it may force him to miss another week. His absence this weekend would be less than ideal for the Bills ahead of a competitive matchup against the Chargers.
items.title: Ed Oliver (hip) misses practice Wednesday

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: The Eagles D/ST allowed 27 points while failing to record a sack or force any turnovers in a 27-7 loss to the Bears in Week 3.
items.impact: It was a poor performance by the Eagles on Monday night as they couldn't stop Case Keenum from carving them up. Keenum hadn't appeared in a regular-season game since 2023, but he tossed two touchdowns and ran for a third. The Eagles will look to regroup in a tough Week 4 matchup against the Rams.
items.title: Eagles D/ST allows 27 points in Week 3

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Jake Elliott was held to one extra point in a 27-7 loss to the Bears in Week 3.
items.impact: Elliott did not attempt any field goals on a rough night for the Eagles on offense. The veteran kicker has now made both of his field-goal attempts and added seven extra points through three games this season. He will take on the Rams in Week 4.
items.title: Jake Elliott makes XP in Week 3

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Zach Ertz caught one of his two targets for a nine-yard gain in a 27-7 loss to the Bears in Week 3.
items.impact: Ertz was signed off of the Eagles' practice squad earlier in the week and suited up for their Monday night matchup against Chicago. With Dallas Goedert (knee) likely a few weeks away from returning, Ertz should continue to operate as Philly's top tight end against the Rams in Week 4.
items.title: Zach Ertz catches one pass in Week 3

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Makai Lemon caught three of his four targets for 29 yards in a 27-7 loss to the Bears in Week 3.
items.impact: Lemon turned in his best game as a pro on Monday night, finishing third on the team in targets and second in catches. The rookie wideout has now caught seven passes for 38 yards through three games. He remains a bench stash in fantasy heading into Week 4 against the Rams.
items.title: Makai Lemon catches three passes in Week 3
